name: wx-vsce-wgsl-shader
description: WGSL and GLSL shader language support: a real language server with completion, hover, go-to-definition, rename, semantic highlighting and diagnostics — WGSL validated by naga, GLSL by its own analyzer in every dialect — in shader files and in shaders embedded in Rust and TypeScript

commands.title: GLSL: Show Shader Stage of Current File

wgsl.validate.onType.description: Validate WGSL files while typing. Off by default: a file is invalid for most of the time it is being edited, and squiggling every keystroke is noise.

wgsl.semanticTokens.description: Colour WGSL by what each name resolves to, rather than by its shape alone.

wgsl.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inlay hints in WGSL files.

wgsl.inlayHints.types.markdownDescription: Show the inferred type of a binding that declares none. Requires `#wgsl.inlayHints.enabled#`.

wgsl.inlayHints.parameterNames.markdownDescription: Show parameter names at call sites — `mix(e1: a, e2: b, e3: t)`. Requires `#wgsl.inlayHints.enabled#`.

wgsl.format.enable.description: Enable the WGSL formatter. It re-indents lines and changes nothing else, so it will not restyle a file written to a house style.

wgsl.embedded.enabled.markdownDescription: Offer WGSL language features inside `/* wgsl */`-tagged string literals in Rust and TypeScript.

wgsl.embedded.diagnostics.markdownDescription: Validate embedded WGSL too. Off by default: a shader inside a string is often a fragment assembled elsewhere, and checking it as a standalone module reports errors about code nobody wrote. Requires `#wgsl.embedded.enabled#`.

glsl.validate.onType.description: Validate GLSL files while typing. Off by default: a file is invalid for most of the time it is being edited, and squiggling every keystroke is noise.

glsl.defaultVersion.patternErrorMessage: Write it the way the directive is: `450`, `330 core`, `300 es`.
glsl.defaultVersion.markdownDescription:
The `#version` to analyse a GLSL file that declares none as, written the way the directive is — `450`, `330 core`, `300 es`.

A file with no `#version` line is GLSL 1.10 by the specification, and that is what an empty value means. It is often not what the author meant: shader fragments assembled at runtime, or compiled with the version supplied on the command line, are ordinary practice, and holding them to 1.10 reports every modern name as missing.

This replaces the former `glsl.validate.dialect`, which existed only to switch naga's Vulkan-only front end off for sources it could not read. GLSL is analysed by this extension's own analyzer now, in every dialect, so the question is no longer whether a file should be checked — it is which GLSL it is.

glsl.semanticTokens.description: Colour GLSL by what each name resolves to, rather than by its shape alone.

glsl.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inlay hints in GLSL files.

glsl.inlayHints.types.markdownDescription: Show the inferred type of a binding that declares none. Requires `#glsl.inlayHints.enabled#`.

glsl.inlayHints.parameterNames.markdownDescription: Show parameter names at call sites — `mix(e1: a, e2: b, e3: t)`. Requires `#glsl.inlayHints.enabled#`.

glsl.format.enable.description: Enable the GLSL formatter. It re-indents lines and changes nothing else, so it will not restyle a file written to a house style.

glsl.embedded.enabled.markdownDescription: Offer GLSL language features inside `/* glsl */`-tagged string literals in Rust and TypeScript.

glsl.embedded.diagnostics.markdownDescription: Validate embedded GLSL too. Off by default: a shader inside a string is often a fragment assembled elsewhere, and checking it as a standalone module reports errors about code nobody wrote. Requires `#glsl.embedded.enabled#`.

glsl.showStageInStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show the GLSL version and shader stage a file is analysed as in the status bar. GLSL has no in-file way to state its stage, so it is taken from `#pragma shader_stage(…)`, then the file extension, then the built-ins the source uses — and a stage that had to be guessed is marked with a `?`.

wgsl.rust.highlightHint.markdownDescription: When a Rust file embeds a shader with the `/* wgsl */` or `/* glsl */` tag, offer to turn off `#rust-analyzer.semanticHighlighting.strings.enable#`. rust-analyzer’s semantic tokens override TextMate scopes, which hides the shader highlighting inside the string.

wgslShader.trace.server.description: Log the traffic between VS Code and the shader language server, in the WGSL / GLSL Shader output channel.

scripts.package: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
